gen.title: How the war for the union became a war for freedom

steps.label: War begins to preserve the union
steps.quote: was fought by the North to prevent the secession of the Southern states and preserve the Union

steps.label: Preliminary order warns rebellious states
steps.quote: That changed on September 22, 1862, when President Lincoln issued his Preliminary Emancipation Proclamation
steps.orderHint: warning that freedom will be declared

steps.label: Final proclamation declares freedom in rebelling areas
steps.quote: One hundred days later, with the rebellion unabated, President issued the Emancipation Proclamation declaring

steps.label: Proclamation limited to seceded states
steps.quote: It applied only to states that had seceded from the Union, leaving slavery untouched in the loyal border states.

steps.label: Union advances expand the domain of freedom
steps.quote: After January 1, 1863, every advance of federal troops expanded the domain of freedom.

steps.label: Black men accepted into union forces
steps.quote: Moreover, the Proclamation announced the acceptance of Black men into the Union Army and Navy, enabling the liberated to become liberators.
